Class UIManager

java.lang.Object
Presentation.UIManager
public class UIManager extends Object
Manages the user interface of the Olympic Games application. Displays menus, requests user input and presents information about delegations, athletes, competitions and simulations.

      public Integer askForIntOrEnter(String prompt, int min, int max)

      private Integer printPaginatedList(ArrayList<String> items, String quantityPrompt, String selectionPrompt)
      Displays a paginated list of items and allows the user to select an item, move to the next page or return. Restarts from the first page after reaching the last page.

      quantityPrompt - the message asking for the page size
      selectionPrompt - the message asking the user to select an item

    • showSimulationResults

      public void showSimulationResults(ArrayList<String> competitionInfo, ArrayList<String> athleteNames, ArrayList<ArrayList<Double>> results, int number, int total)
      Displays the results of a simulated Olympic competition. Shows the competition information, athlete rankings, luck factors, completion times and medal winners.
      Parameters:
      competitionInfo - the competition identifier, name and format
      athleteNames - the names of the athletes in ranking order
      results - the luck factor and completion time of each athlete
      number - the current competition number
      total - the total number of competitions
